title: More voltage and stored energy
hook: Change voltage magnitude and predict stored electric energy.
misconception: stored electric energy doubles when voltage magnitude doubles, regardless of the stated relationship.
objective: Apply U = CV²/2 to compare stored electric energy when voltage magnitude changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With an ideal capacitor with fixed capacitance, U = CV²/2. When voltage magnitude doubles, stored electric energy becomes 4 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model U = CV²/2; scaling exponent 2. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider an ideal capacitor with fixed capacitance, with a nonzero initial result. If voltage magnitude triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on stored electric energy?
recall.why: Apply U = CV²/2 under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 9.
